scope: Direct TypeSafe System One decision-provider adapter outside frozen baseline. Validated bindings, dedicated credentials, bounded transport, typed questions and catalog integration.

features: Direct TypeSafe System One API client with bounded 64 KiB request size and 1 MiB response cap
Explicit credential isolation: never borrows OpenRouter, OpenCode or OpenAI keys
Automatic retry with exponential backoff on transient errors (rate_limited, unreachable) up to 3 attempts
Fail-fast behavior on unauthorized and configuration errors with zero retries
Full choice, boolean (noul) and ordered score question/answer parsing through shared typed runtime
Clean rejection of image URLs (TypeSafe System One is text/state only)
Studio decision workflow execution, routing, confidence thresholds and error escalation
Catalog decisionmodels resource preset support and NexusTeamPolicy decision_keys mapping
UI support in workbench decisions and decisionmodels catalog settings
